source.title: Duskwood Mission I: Defeat Worgen
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard. Defeat worgen there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 10 Nightmare Runners and 10 Nightmare Weavers in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
